body_html:
On this Saint Patrick's Day I am missing the #PlanetMcVerry facebook group. We connected to so many branches of the family that fled Armagh, fought for Armargh, feared Armargh, and those who happily call Armargh home today.

Mainly we shared cat and kid pictures new and old.

We just became friends and family with a shared past that spanned the globe.

The group obviously gets a bit active today and had such a wonderful bricolage of different cultures as love and time threw us all into the great remix machine of life.

For all those whom I will not speak to today much love to you and yours and all in between.
